status_definitions.observed: files cover the month and >=1 detection day in district
status_definitions.insufficient: files cover the month but no detection day in district
status_definitions.incomplete: month only partially covered by delivered files
status_definitions.missing: month in availability span but no file delivered
status_definitions.not_requested: month within sensor availability but outside acquisition plan (Aug-Dec; data exists at FIRMS but was not acquired)
status_definitions.unavailable: month before sensor SP availability start

note: Missing months are never filled with zeros; detections are not unique fires.
